# 2027 Sphere Medical & HSA Year-End Reconciliation

**Coverage:** Individual HDHP, January 1–December 31, 2027  
**Use:** Enter amounts from pay statements and HSA transaction history. All actual-value fields below are intentionally blank.

## Expected figures for comparison (not statement values)

| Item | 2027 expected amount | Basis |
|---|---:|---|
| Employee medical-plan deductions | $2,548.00 | $98 × 26 biweekly paychecks |
| Employee HSA payroll contributions | $2,340.00 | $90 × 26 biweekly paychecks |
| Sphere employer HSA contributions | $900.00 | 4 × $225 scheduled deposits |
| Total planned HSA funding | $3,240.00 | Employee + employer contributions |

## Payroll statement ledger

Enter the amounts actually shown on each statement. Use 0.00 if a deduction is explicitly zero; leave entries blank until checked.

| # | Pay date | Medical deduction (actual) | Employee HSA contribution (actual) | Notes / statement reference |

| **Actual total** | | | | |
| **Expected total** | | **$2,548.00** | **$2,340.00** | |
| **Difference (actual − expected)** | | | | |

## HSA employer deposit reconciliation

Compare the HSA custodian’s posted transactions—not merely the benefits schedule. Record each posted deposit once.

| Scheduled period | Expected deposit | Posted date | Actual posted amount | Notes / transaction reference |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| January | $225.00 | | | |
| April | $225.00 | | | |
| July | $225.00 | | | |
| October | $225.00 | | | |
| **Actual employer total** | **$900.00 expected** | | | |
| **Difference (actual − expected)** | | | | |

## Year-end totals and checks

| Reconciliation item | Expected | Actual from records | Difference (actual − expected) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Medical deductions from pay statements | $2,548.00 | | |
| Employee HSA contributions from pay statements | $2,340.00 | | |
| Employer HSA deposits from HSA transaction history | $900.00 | | |
| Combined HSA contributions (employee + employer) | $3,240.00 | | |

**Checks:** Count 26 pay statements; confirm each medical deduction and employee HSA contribution against the statement; confirm four employer deposits against posted HSA transactions; investigate any missing, duplicate, reversed, or differing entry. Do not treat the medical premium deduction as HSA funding. Contributions shown here are funding flows, not the HSA account’s ending balance (which can also reflect spending, fees, interest, or investment activity).

**Reconciliation notes / follow-up:**
